description: District metadata by state and type (GET /v1/districts): congressional, state senate, state house. Pass district_id with boundary:true to get the polygon as GeoJSON (GET /v1/districts/{id}/boundary) — it is large, so set simplify (degrees, e.g. 0.01) to shrink it. Match districts NUMERICALLY (district_number), never by label text.

boundary.description: true = return the GeoJSON polygon for district_id.

district_id.description: A district id from a previous list call (for boundary:true).

name: list_districts
title: Electoral districts (and boundaries)
